==Age==


In Lord of Chaos, there is a quote from Gawyn's POV indicating that he is roughly twenty-three to twenty-five years old, indicating a birth year of around 974-976.

<u>Lord of Chaos CHAPTER: Prologue - The First Message</u><br />Gawyn himself, a few years past twenty, was among the oldest.
